description: Same rules as the homelab-stacks preset renovate-apps.json on repo.billbert.co, copied here because the hosted Renovate app cannot read that server. No automerge: nothing health-checks or rolls back the image a merge produces.

packageRules.description: Pin Dockerfile FROM lines to digests so a rebuild uses the same base image until a PR moves it.
Group non-major updates per manager to keep the PR count low.
